user.title: SmartNest Dashboard
user.description: Adds the SmartNest dashboard to the sidebar. Admins can edit it; everyone else just uses it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: SmartNest Dashboard is already set up.

show_message.name: Show a message on the home screens
show_message.description: Pops a message up on every open SmartNest dashboard. With `ack`, it shows a button and fires smartnest_message_ack when pressed.

title.name: Title
title.description: Shown above the message, e.g. who it's from.

ack.name: Button
ack.description: Text of a confirm button, e.g. "Taken ✓".
